org.portico.impl.hla13.types

Class Java1ByteArrayMap

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.impl.hla13.types.Java1ByteArrayMap
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    public class Java1ByteArrayMap
extends Object
implements Serializable
    This class provides the common Map "functionality" required by the HLA 1.3 spec. Implementations for SuppliedAttributes and SuppliedParameters can just extend it to get the required functionality.

      • toJavaMap

        public HashMap<Integer,byte[]> toJavaMap()
        Non-standard method to help ease some insanity.

        Convert this into a proper java map. NOTE: The returned map is not tied in any way to this map. If you add an element to one, it will not appear in the other.
